behavior.abnormal_definition: evidence-triggered deviation from the actor's own established baseline

cadence.quarterly: refresh deterministic evidence graph and unresolved-thread index when new batch exists
cadence.on_demand: allow read-only diagnostic whenever the user asks about narrative readiness

adaptation_gate.reason: 2031 housing/city lock-in, real family evidence, new-job consequences and underrepresented original-cast lives are still structurally open
adaptation_gate.small_literary_probes: may be allowed later as noncanonical tests, but are not part of the current data-building phase

backend_contract.chatgpt_product_conversation: read structured state/evidence from GitHub, reason in current ChatGPT product conversation, write only validated cognition artifacts through GitHub connector; no repository model API call
backend_contract.deepseek_api: may implement the same cognition task/result schemas later
backend_contract.local_model: may implement the same cognition task/result schemas later
backend_contract.deterministic_control: may build evidence indices but cannot fabricate interpretive world facts

invariants: Storyteller never changes relationships, candidate status, jobs, housing, family events or publications
Actor chronology is not automatically treated as causality
Candidate lifecycle edges are mechanical; broader causal arcs remain interpretations
Absence of evidence can be reported as a gap but cannot be filled by invention
Literary prose remains disabled during the current historical-data phase
